I can do that — a couple quick clarifications so I reschedule the right event and don’t make the wrong change:

1) Which Thursday do you mean (date)? Or should I pick the next upcoming Thursday?  
2) Is this a one-time move (just that occurrence) or should I move the entire recurring series?  
3) Confirm event title and attendees: event titled "Design Review" (or other?), attendees = you, Kiran, Dana, no others? Keep same conferencing/location?

If you want me to assume "next Thursday" and "only this occurrence" with the details you gave (Friday 10:00 AM, 45 minutes, Europe/London, same three attendees), reply "Go ahead" and I’ll make the change.
